review.notes: Triage coverage: full-document structural scan (one balanced code fence holding the printed Algorithm 1 pseudo-code; no unbalanced fences) plus a machine page-text diff of all 68 physical pages using normalized 4-gram containment with HTML table tags stripped; the initial run flagged table pages spuriously because <td> residue broke cell-boundary grams, and the corrected scan resolved every remaining low page (1, 3, 5, 7, 10, 14-24, 36, 50, 51) as figure-internal chart labels, LaTeX-equivalent math for equations (6)-(8), or the printed arXiv cover stamp - no prose or table droppage found. All tables and figure captions matched between PDF text and OCR. Rendered pages inspected visually: 50 (B.1 MTOB box), 51 (B.2 MR-NIAH box), 52 (B.3 Stream-Aligner box), 58 (B.5 lyrics box), 62 (C.1 Example 1 box); remaining appendix pages share the identical printed box style, and font-size analysis plus the PDF text layer confirmed each demoted line is in-box label or demo content (10.9 pt body for the promoted Contributions sentence on p.3; 6-12 pt Roman/Bold in-box text elsewhere) rather than a printed section heading (~14 pt bold). The defect class is OCR promotion of demo-box banners, box titles, in-box transcript section titles, lyric markers and one body sentence to '##' headings; patches only strip the spurious '## ' prefix except where noted. Not line-by-line: full prose was machine-scanned; appendix demo-box interior text is represented in the OCR both as figure-image embeds and transcribed text, and image embeds were left untouched.

unresolved.evidence: The printed banner font maps its arrow/enter glyphs to unreliable ToUnicode codes (the PDF text layer yields '➷' and a bare 'P' where the rendered page shows an enter-style arrow and a PDF icon); the OCR transcriptions '↩', '↗', '↙' were kept because the exact printed codepoints are not recoverable from either source.

Some demo-box interiors (B.1 prompt, B.2 dialogue pills and Suboptimal answer) appear in the OCR only as figure-image embeds while sibling boxes are fully transcribed; the content is represented, but coverage inside those images was not re-verified character by character.
